request: Read-only determine whether approved original 18080 legacy entrypoint is actually live and which existing router container owns it. No router startup, port publication, Docker mutation or direct backend access.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
names=$(docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}={{.State}}' | grep -Ei 'llama.router|llama.swap|ai.router' | head -8 | tr '\n' ';' || :)
if ss -H -ltn 'sport = :18080' | grep -q LISTEN; then listener=YES; else listener=NO; fi
msg="AI_CORE_LEGACY_18080_DISCOVERY ROUTER_CONTAINERS=$names PORT_18080_LISTEN=$listener DIRECT_BACKEND_TCP=NOT_REOPENED"
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq .html_url >/dev/null
echo AI_CORE_LEGACY_ROUTER_DISCOVERY=POSTED

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: AI Core Current#1 updated with actual Astera independent adapter inference PASS #6225180527 and post-inference resource #6225204612; adopted design §8/§11 still expects legacy 18080 compatibility and rollback, whereas current Gate Source docstring retires legacy. Need observe actual 18080 listener and container without starting it; last Host SHA ee6002 #6225205321.
